entities.name: NR Sidelink Measurement
entities.description: Procedure for deriving NR sidelink measurement results by measuring DMRS associated per PC5-RRC connection. The UE applies layer 3 filtering before using measured results for evaluation of reporting criteria and measurement reporting.

entities.name: DMRS
entities.description: Demodulation Reference Signals used for NR sidelink measurements when sl-RS-Type is set to dmrs.

entities.name: Layer 3 Filtering
entities.description: Filtering applied to NR sidelink measurement results as specified in clause 5.5.3.2 before using them for evaluation of reporting criteria and measurement reporting.

entities.name: sl-MeasId
entities.description: Measurement identifier included in the sl-MeasIdList within VarMeasConfigSL.

entities.name: sl-MeasIdList
entities.description: List containing sl-MeasId identifiers within VarMeasConfigSL.

entities.name: sl-MeasObject
entities.description: Measurement object associated to NR sidelink.

entities.name: sl-RS-Type set to dmrs
entities.description: Condition where the sl-RS-Type is configured as dmrs for NR sidelink measurements.

entities.name: NR Sidelink RSRP
entities.description: Reference Signal Received Power for NR sidelink, which can be configured as trigger quantity and reporting quantity in this release.

entities.name: sl-ReportQuantity
entities.description: Indicates the measurement quantities for reporting.

entities.name: Evaluation of Reporting Criteria
entities.description: Procedure for evaluating reporting criteria as specified in 5.8.10.4.

relations.description: NR sidelink measurement procedure involves measuring DMRS associated per PC5-RRC connection.
NR sidelink measurement procedure includes applying layer 3 filtering to measurement results.
NR sidelink measurement procedure is performed for each sl-MeasId in sl-MeasIdList.
sl-MeasId is included in the sl-MeasIdList within VarMeasConfigSL.
NR sidelink measurement procedure is conditioned on sl-RS-Type being set to dmrs.
Condition sl-RS-Type set to dmrs requires sl-MeasObject to be associated to NR sidelink.
NR sidelink measurement procedure can use NR sidelink RSRP as trigger quantity and reporting quantity.
NR sidelink measurement procedure uses sl-ReportQuantity to indicate measurement quantities for reporting.
NR sidelink measurement procedure includes evaluation of reporting criteria as specified in 5.8.10.4.
